title: Hearthside
description: Hearthside is a cozy, Vanilla+ survival modpack focused on building a home, exploring beautiful landscapes, and following light quests. It also includes a touch of tech for automation and helpful QoL machines —comfort first, grind last.
body:
# Hearthside
![Hearthside Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ba1eab979956cb61a54fe8bfdd94716f4b36adb.png)
**Hearthside** is a cozy, Vanilla+ Minecraft modpack focused on building a warm home, exploring at a relaxed pace, and enjoying gentle progression without turning the game into a grind. It’s for players who like peaceful survival, pretty worlds, and lots of time to decorate, farm, and settle in—with the option to expand into tech when you feel like it.

## What this modpack offers

**A comfy survival loop**: gather, build, cook, decorate, and slowly upgrade your home base.

**Exploration that feels rewarding**: new places to see and things to find, but with comfort-first pacing (not nonstop danger or brutal difficulty spikes).

**“Homestead tech” that’s becoming more serious**: it started as small-scale convenience—storage, processing, simple automation—but **Hearthside** is gradually leaning into more technical systems for players who want to go further.

## Why download Hearthside?

If you want Minecraft to feel like a calm evening project—build a cabin, grow a farm, organize storage, take scenic trips, and gradually add helpful automation - **Hearthside** is built for that “homey” vibe. And if you do get the itch to optimize? The pack increasingly supports that too, without forcing you into it from day one.
